title: Karpathy AI capability funnel (edited X post)
evidence_quality: Primary metadata; full wording from unofficial archive
limitations: Original ID 2109361082217402758 at 19:10:46 UTC; edit at 19:12:37 UTC. Full long-post text was not exposed by primary syndication; edit wording cannot be independently fully verified. Counts are napkin estimates.

title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
limitations: Broad researcher definition; unknown headcount; zero usage included for expenditure; no employee microdata; programmatic automations excluded; internal models mapped to production counterparts; prices frozen 2026-09-03.

title: The Shift to Agentic AI: Evidence from Codex
author_organization: Johnston, Holtz, Richmond, Ong, Tambe, Chatterji / OpenAI
limitations: Internal workers are not restricted to researchers. Daily runtime excludes inactive accounts and noninteractive batch use; task runtime includes short waits and tools. Token levels indexed, not absolute.

title: Manage costs effectively
limitations: Sample size, averaging scheme, model mix, price date, contracted discounts and measurement dates undisclosed. Headline cost is not independently audited billing.

title: How People Use ChatGPT
author_organization: Chatterji, Cunningham, Deming, Hitzig, Ong, Shan, Wadman / OpenAI and Harvard
limitations: Consumer is not synonymous with casual or free. Weekly users are not daily users; aggregates do not identify median consumption or token lengths. Rounded aggregate values.

title: How AI is transforming work at Anthropic
measurement_period: Survey August 2025; transcripts February and August 2025
scope: Engineers and researchers; internal Claude Code
limitations: 132 survey respondents; 53 interviews; 200,000 transcripts. Convenience/purposive sampling. Proportionate transcript sampling prevents inference about absolute growth.

title: Agentic coding and persistent returns to expertise
author_organization: Hitzig, Massenkoff, Lyubich, Zhang, Heller, McCrory / Anthropic
limitations: ~400,000 sampled sessions; headless, SDK and third-party IDE use excluded. Words/actions per prompt are not per-person-day token counts.

title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Cadences
scope: Work-related Claude conversations, Cowork and API
limitations: Token values normalized to overall median; caption geometric-mean vs main-text median ambiguity. No absolute user-day denominator.

title: The Cursor Developer Habits Report
measurement_period: Time series 2026-01-01 to 2026-05-09; other windows not fully disclosed
limitations: Token/spend Lorenz series and mixes are aggregate/cohort measures. No absolute daily token or spend level, no user-level bootstrap.

title: The asymmetry of token consumption
limitations: Exact total token volume, cohort count and model breakdown missing. Most-engaged cohort wording not treated as general population.

title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot at Production Scale
author_organization: Liu, Qiu, Goiri, Fonseca, Bianchini, Choukse / Microsoft, UIUC
scope: Copilot coding-agent traces; US regions; 3.2M users
limitations: Abstract reports 95T tokens; Table 3 prompt total 44.9T and completion 39.3B. Completion total implies mean 51.7/call, inconsistent with median 247 and Table 4 mean 4,000/turn. Models anonymized; reasoning omitted. Quarantined user-day token derivations.

title: GitHub Copilot Coding Agent Traces 2026 dataset card
scope: Uniform sample of non-enterprise agentic sessions
limitations: 301,026 sessions; user/account IDs and real model names omitted. Full archives about 3GB were not downloaded; published metadata reviewed. No per-user normalization possible.

title: Alphabet investor presentation: June 2026
limitations: Aggregate internally processed tokens, no active user count, cache/output split, researcher subset or inference cost.

title: Mister IA Panel: usage indicators
scope: Client employees with Claude/ChatGPT licences; >10,000 licences across >=10 clients
limitations: Monthly active denominator; no outputs, full model-input history, model IDs or per-user distribution. Consulting-client selection.

title: The Evaluation of the M365 Copilot Pilot in DBT
author_organization: UK Department for Business and Trade
limitations: 72 actions per licence over 63 working days; absences and non-use included. Active-user definition is internally inconsistent between daily/weekly passages. No token counts.

title: The State of Enterprise AI 2025
limitations: Growth figures relative; organization reasoning tokens are not individual employee consumption. Workplace seats not active users.

title: When AI builds itself
limitations: Code production and self-reported productivity are not inference; unreleased model access documented but not quantified per person.

title: Automated Weak-to-Strong Researcher
author_organization: Wen, Qiu, Benton, Kirchner, Leike / Anthropic
publication_date: 2026-04 (linked by S17; exact date not exposed)
limitations: 18,000 USD includes compute and API calls; training/experimentation mixed in. Cannot assign to human researcher-day inference.

title: Pricing: Claude Platform
limitations: Price depends on model, context, cache TTL, batch, geography and speed; not underlying compute cost.

title: Pricing: OpenAI API
limitations: Standard/Fast/Flex/batch and context tiers differ; internal models cannot be repriced without traffic-level identities.

title: Pricing: ChatGPT Learn / Codex
limitations: Messages/5h are task-dependent estimates, not fixed token caps; Pro currently no five-hour cap; weekly limits and credits matter.

title: Gemini Apps limits and upgrades
limitations: Capacity multipliers are not consumption or FLOP multipliers. Model names, regional access and limits can change.

title: Use Claude Code with your Pro or Max plan
limitations: Shared five-hour and weekly limits; separate Fable weekly cap; no stable absolute token budget.

title: LLM inference prices have fallen rapidly but unequally across tasks
author_organization: Cottier, Snodin, Owen, Adamczewski / Epoch AI
limitations: Benchmark-conditioned price declines are not declines at moving frontier; model quality and token conventions differ.

title: September 2026 Ramp AI Index
measurement_period: July and August 2026; price index September 2026
scope: US business transactions; firm spending cohorts
limitations: Firm-level spending divided by employee count includes subscriptions and production API use; not employee personal inference. July top1% revised from ~7.4k to 7,976.

title: The only metric that matters in tokenomics
scope: One external operator, two machines, all models/workloads
limitations: 130,000 USD list-equivalent claim with subscription marginal bill zero; includes broader scope than OpenAI interactive telemetry. No raw billing/token audit supplied.

title: How Organizations Use AI: Evidence from ChatGPT
author_organization: Chatterji, Holtz, Rakholia, Tambe, Weeratunga / OpenAI
scope: Enterprise firms and workers; >1,500 role-covered organizations
limitations: Indexed output growth; role-specific messages reported as differences. No comparable absolute user-day tokens. Firm output tokens not equivalent to role-specific user consumption.

title: How US Youth Use AI Chatbots
author_organization: Maheux et al. / UNC Chapel Hill and Aura
scope: 3,363 US youth using Aura overlay keyboard
limitations: Median 6 messages/app-day, mean 44.52; assistant outputs not observed; selection and app mix; not adult casual users. Confusing use of on average in prose.

title: Karpathy post archive
evidence_quality: Secondary archive used only for full-post paraphrase
limitations: Primary metadata independently recovered; archived full text and original-versus-edited differences not fully verified.

title: How much energy does Google AI use?
measurement_period: 2025 production text prompts; see technical paper
limitations: Per-prompt median cannot be multiplied into a daily mean without prompt distribution; not transferable to frontier research workloads.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
limitations: Total and active parameters differ; architecture is not evidence of per-user inference consumption.

title: Anthropic Economic Index public dataset
limitations: No person-day traffic linkage, complete token ledger or stable individual activity denominator identified in dataset card.

title: Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice
scope: Interactive Claude Code turns and public API interactions
limitations: Turn duration percentiles are not per-user daily runtime or GPU-hours. Noninteractive contexts differ.

title: Is tokenmaxxing cost effective? New data from Jellyfish explains.
limitations: 12,000 developers, 200 companies; model mix, active-day count, zero inclusion and exact price date undisclosed. Monthly quantiles cannot become daily quantiles.

title: The State of AI in Software Engineering: H1 2026
limitations: Different charts use different cohorts and aggregation levels. Table Tokens/User period and statistic unspecified; cost column explicitly per month. Price basis not frozen.

title: State of AI Coding Spend 2026
scope: Self-selected developer submissions; highest-cost submission per developer
limitations: 792 submitters; highest-cost submission selection; employee affiliation not verified. API-equivalent prices not one common frozen date. Tracked coding days are user-days; not general developers.

title: AI coding usage data: Viberank API snapshot
scope: Developer highest-cost submissions, minimum seven covered days, normalized to 30-day month
limitations: Monthly distribution n=1,220; global totals n=1,309 are a different scope. activeDays=645 is not summed user-days. Self-selection and maximum-submission bias; affiliation unverified.

title: From Awareness to Action? The Impact of CO2 Emission Feedback on Student LLM Usage
author_organization: Lisa Bondo Andersen et al. / LMU and MCML
scope: 37 undergraduate statistics students using an optional Azure-hosted educational platform
evidence_quality: Primary conference paper; author-posted full PDF retrieved
limitations: 43 registered from 461 invited; six single-prompt users excluded; 781 text prompts. Intervention and exam period; other apps untracked. Per-prompt means, not daily-active quantiles. Author copy: ResearchGate publication 403751970.

title: The First Generative AI Prompt-A-Thon in Healthcare
author_organization: William Small et al. / NYU Langone and Microsoft
scope: Mixed healthcare workforce at a selected instructional event
evidence_quality: Primary peer-reviewed telemetry study, CC BY
limitations: Only 949 of 1,944 prompts had retrievable text; staff/resource scope differs from 70 in-person attendees. Token means and prompts/user cannot be multiplied into measured individual totals.

title: Enterprise signals: What frontier firms are doing differently
measurement_period: January-June 2026; other activity dates not explicit
scope: Enterprise customers ranked monthly by output tokens per active user; top 10% vs 45th-55th percentile firms
limitations: Firms re-ranked each month; aggregate group statistic unspecified. Output includes Codex and ChatGPT, not all API consumption. No absolute daily level; frontier firm is not frontier laboratory.

title: Measuring AI Agent Concurrency
scope: Claude Code users at Jellyfish customer companies
limitations: 19M active-time rows, not users. One harness only; internal subagents invisible; concurrency refers to simultaneously active sessions. No person-day token ledger.

title: Where AI agent tokens go: Claude Code and Codex usage, measured
evidence_quality: Primary self-reported log audit with open-source parser
limitations: No raw private logs audited; publication/log date discrepancy. 503M Codex tokens unpriced; Codex cache writes omitted; costs priced September 30. No representative population.

title: TokenBudgeting: Our Conversations with Enterprises on Token Spend
author_organization: Crystal Huang, Joey Brookhart, Dylan Patel / SemiAnalysis
measurement_period: H1 2026 and interviews around Databricks AI Summit
scope: 50-plus interviewed enterprises; separate Meta and internal SemiAnalysis cases
evidence_quality: Original field interviews and self-reports; Meta telemetry reported indirectly
limitations: Convenience interviews; contract vs list-price accounting unclear. Meta dashboard not publicly audited; workforce denominator and token mix absent. Budgets are capacities, not use.

title: AgentX - InferenceXv3: Does CUDA Moat Hold up in Agentic Inferencing?
scope: Internal SemiAnalysis power users and volunteered agent traffic
evidence_quality: Primary trace collection and benchmark report
limitations: No user count or matched observation period. Acquisition expenditure scope unclear. Live article may have evolved since original date. Replayed open-weight models do not identify original closed-model compute.

title: AgentX Claude Code Weka traces dataset card
measurement_period: Selected collected sessions; absolute person-days absent
scope: Filtered selected Claude Code sessions, minimum 20 requests and concurrency <=10 subagent groups
limitations: Input is reconstructed 64-token KV-block count, not exact billed tokens; can overcount by ~260k in heavy-cache-write tail. Only relative timestamps; no person-day denominator.
